titleEn: Moyu (摸鱼): The Art of Slacking Off at Work — China's 'Quiet Quitting' Cousin
summaryEn: Moyu, literally 'groping fish', means slacking off at work while looking busy — meetings on mute, shopping at your desk, the protest against overtime.
emotionEquivalentEn: slacking off / goofing off at work

symbolLayer.explanation: 成语「浑水摸鱼」的截短活用：只留动作+对象，自带画面感；「在水里摸鱼」原指趁浑水捞鱼
symbolLayer.explanationEn: A clipped use of the idiom 'groping fish in muddy water': action + object only, inherently visual; originally meant profiting from chaos.

origin: 源自成语「浑水摸鱼」（趁乱牟利）；2020 年左右在职场语境中语义漂移为「上班时间偷懒」
originEn: From the idiom 'groping fish in muddy water' (profiting from chaos); around 2020 its meaning drifted to 'slacking off at work'.
usage: 「在摸鱼」= 正在偷懒；「摸鱼神器」= 帮助伪装工作的工具；与「带薪拉屎」同属职场消极抵抗词汇群
usageEn: 'Slacking off' at work while appearing busy; 'moyu gadgets' = tools that help fake work; related to 'paid pooping' as workplace-resistance vocabulary.
commonMisreading: 容易被读成纯粹的懒惰；实际是 996 高压下的微型抵抗，与 quiet quitting 同属一个情绪谱系
commonMisreadingEn: Easily read as plain laziness; it's actually micro-resistance under 996 pressure — the same emotional spectrum as quiet quitting.

memeLineage.event: 成语「浑水摸鱼」在职场语境漂移为「上班偷懒」，在贴吧/微博流行
memeLineage.eventEn: The idiom's meaning drifts to 'slacking at work'; spreads on Tieba and Weibo

memeLineage.event: 「摸鱼神器」搜索量暴涨，衍生壁纸、脚本等工具化内容
memeLineage.eventEn: 'Moyu gadgets' search volume spikes; wallpapers and scripts follow

memeLineage.event: 与 quiet quitting 对照讨论，「摸鱼」被定位为微观抵抗
memeLineage.eventEn: Discussed alongside quiet quitting; 'moyu' framed as micro-resistance

memeLineage.event: 外媒将摸鱼与「带薪拉屎」并称中式摸鱼文化，Reddit 讨论引入
memeLineage.eventEn: Foreign media group moyu with 'paid pooping' as Chinese slack culture; Reddit picks it up

memeLineage.event: 「摸鱼」概念回流为「工资小偷」等英语段子
memeLineage.eventEn: The concept flows back as 'wage thief' English jokes
